title: Moesha
description:
S3 E4 — Age Ain't Nothin' But a Number
Hakeem begins to date an older woman he meets at his store.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E5 — My Mom’s Not An Ottoman
Dee wins a free decorating consultation at Mo’s school raffle and can’t wait to redo the house.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E6 — The Play Scene
Mo writes a scene from a play set in a Blues Lounge in the 1940s for her English class, and our cast acts it out for us.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E7 — Use Me Once Shame On You, Use Me Twice I’ll Kill You
Mo tells her friends at the Den that Hayley’s dad is an important record executive.

S3 E24 — The Butler Did It
When Mary and Rose win the services of a butler in the church raffle, they look forward to the pampered life until they meet the pain-in-the-neck hired help.

S2 E1 — The Handwriting On The Wall
Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E7 — Trading Spaces
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E8 — Like Water For Chocolate Cookies
Malcolm faces a difficult decision in order to get Simone to keep making her extraordinary cookies.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E9 — Dream Racer
Eddie ignores Nicolette's premonition and agrees to fill in for an injured race car driver.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E10 — Hoop Schemes
In order to impress Nicolette and humiliate a potential suitor, Eddie steps in for Malcolm to coach a youth basketball team.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E11 — Two Men And A Baby
Eddie enlists Malcolm to help babysit for his infant cousin.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.
